responseStudy.scope: Train response supervision only, same fixed encoder/constructor/GRU and parent action weights
responseStudy.conditions: aligned: original fixed Train draws with no extra response corruption; sampled: eight independently seeded future Train rollouts per action, their mean return, and a separate behavior draw refreshed each iteration
responseStudy.reference: Prior precision-v1/value uses the same numeric FP32 model and budget with extra noise 0.1; preserved as historical comparison
responseStudy.training: Seed 42, same two policy iterations, max 40 epochs, optimizer, batches and Dev selector; sampled uses eight times the return samples, not eight times the gradient updates
responseStudy.environment: Original missing/partial manager replies remain. A Train-only seed never enters observed inputs. Seeded retail replies are keyed by action, independent of question order. Default Dev/Test response hashes are unchanged.
responseStudy.selection: Equal benchmark-normalized Dev means, with raw generated loss <= 147.6812873023908 and retail <= 44.32742132570505, no false handoffs, no increase in unnecessary retail requests, no loss of parameter/evidence accuracy, identical frozen weights. Require strict improvement beyond rounding before promotion.
responseStudy.limitations: Generated Train/Dev responses, one training seed, 12 generated Dev families and five fully observed retail Dev periods; no real-organization or fresh Test effectiveness claim.
